compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
- DD2: Open-PR check uses 3-tier fallback chain enumerating BOTH main PR AND sub-PRs.
- DD5: Unit tests for all new/modified logic.

## Implementation Notes

Create `tests/scripts/test-worktree-removal-guards.sh` covering the library at `plugins/dso/scripts/lib/worktree-removal-guards.sh` (which T2 will create).

Test cases (Given / When / Then; all fail RED until T2):

**Protected branch guard**:
- Given branch = 'main' → guard fires (refusal)
- Given branch = 'master' → guard fires
- Given branch = 'develop' → guard fires
- Given branch = 'release/v1.2.3' → guard fires (release/* glob)
- Given branch = 'session/abc' → guard does NOT fire

**Uncommitted/unpushed guard**:
- Given worktree with modified file (uncommitted) → guard fires
- Given worktree with committed-but-unpushed commits → guard fires (use 'git log @{u}..' check)
- Given worktree with clean tree, all pushed → guard does NOT fire

**Open-PR-with-CI guard (3-tier fallback)**:
- Tier 1: gh pr list --head <branch> --state open returns 1 → guard fires; PR URL captured
- Tier 1 returns 0; Tier 2 (gh api commits/<sha>/pulls open) returns 1 → guard fires
- Tiers 1+2 return 0; Tier 3 (gh pr list --search 'head:<branch>') returns 1 → guard fires
- All 3 tiers return 0 → guard does NOT fire
- Sub-PR enumeration: tier 1 finds 2 open PRs (main + sub-PR) → guard fires; refusal lists BOTH PR URLs

**assert_worktree_removable orchestrator**:
- Any single guard firing → exit non-zero, refusal message identifies WHICH guard
- --force flag → guards still RUN, refusal message + PR URL still print, exit code 0

Tests use mocked `gh` and `git` commands via PATH manipulation or function override. Pattern: source library with `_GUARDS_SOURCE_ONLY=1` flag (analogous to `_CLAUDE_SAFE_SOURCE_ONLY` in claude-safe).

Add `.test-index` RED marker `[test_worktree_removal_guards]`.

## File Impact

| Source file | Action | Tests | Class |
|-------------|--------|-------|-------|
| `tests/scripts/test-worktree-removal-guards.sh` | create | (this IS the test) | needs-creation |
| `.test-index` | modify | n/a | marker |

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: TEST_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test) && [ -n "$TEST_CMD" ] && $TEST_CMD
- [ ] Test file exists and is executable
  Verify: test -x tests/scripts/test-worktree-removal-guards.sh
- [ ] Test covers all 3 guards + 3-tier fallback + --force bypass
  Verify: grep -cE 'protected|uncommitted|open.PR|--force|tier' tests/scripts/test-worktree-removal-guards.sh | awk '{exit (\$1>=5?0:1)}'
- [ ] Test is initially RED (library doesn't exist)
  Verify: ! bash tests/scripts/test-worktree-removal-guards.sh
- [ ] .test-index updated with RED marker
  Verify: grep '\[test_worktree_removal_guards\]' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.test-index

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet); on 3 failures escalate to opus; on 3 more escalate to user.

comments.body:
AC AMENDMENTS (plan-review F1, F2, F5 + gap-analysis):

**gh CLI unavailability (plan-review F1 critical)**: Add test cases for fail-CLOSED behavior:
- Given 'gh' not in PATH → assert_worktree_removable exits non-zero with GUARD_PR_CHECK_UNAVAILABLE: gh CLI not installed
- Given 'gh auth status' returns non-zero → assert_worktree_removable exits non-zero with GUARD_PR_CHECK_UNAVAILABLE: gh not authenticated
- Given 'gh' returns HTTP 403 (rate-limit) → assert_worktree_removable exits non-zero with GUARD_PR_CHECK_UNAVAILABLE: rate-limited
- Sanctioned override: WORKTREE_REMOVAL_SKIP_PR_CHECK=1 + WORKTREE_REMOVAL_SKIP_PR_CHECK_REASON=<text>; both required for bypass; single var insufficient.

**Sub-PR enumeration (plan-review F2 major)**: Tier 1 (gh pr list --head <session>) finds MAIN PR ONLY. Sub-PRs have head=story/<epic>/<story>, NOT the session branch. Required enumeration:
- Source A: gh pr list --head <session-branch> --state open (main session\xe2\x86\x92main PR)
- Source B: gh pr list --base <session-branch> --state open (ALL sub-PRs whose BASE is the session branch \xe2\x80\x94 includes story/* sub-PRs)
- Source C: 3-tier fallback (commits/<sha>/pulls + gh pr list --search) applied to BOTH session-branch and any sub-branches discovered in Source B for completeness
- Union all results, dedup by PR number.

Add test case: 'two PRs in flight — main session\xe2\x86\x92main + sub-PR story/X/Y\xe2\x86\x92session/abc' — assert BOTH PR URLs appear in refusal message.

**Worktree-path quoting (gap-analysis #5)**: Add test cases for worktree paths containing:
- a space ('worktree with space')
- a unicode character ('caf\xc3\xa9-worktree')
- a leading dash ('-startsWithDash')
Each must be correctly handled without word-splitting, glob-expansion, or flag-confusion.

**gh mock pattern (plan-review F5 minor)**: PATH override (create $TMPDIR/bin/gh as executable stub, prepend to PATH) — NOT bash function override. Function overrides don't propagate to subprocesses; the library spawns gh as a subprocess.

Additional AC items:
- [ ] Test covers gh unavailability fail-closed (all 3 modes)
  Verify: grep -cE 'PATH unset|gh auth status.*fail|rate.limit' tests/scripts/test-worktree-removal-guards.sh | awk '{exit ($1>=2?0:1)}'
- [ ] Test covers sub-PR enumeration via --base (not just --head)
  Verify: grep -qE 'gh pr list --base|--base <session' tests/scripts/test-worktree-removal-guards.sh
- [ ] Test covers special-char worktree paths
  Verify: grep -qE 'space|caf|unicode|leading.dash' tests/scripts/test-worktree-removal-guards.sh
- [ ] Test uses PATH override (not bash function) for gh mock
  Verify: grep -qE 'mktemp.*bin|PATH=.*bin|chmod +x.*gh' tests/scripts/test-worktree-removal-guards.sh
